candidates.content_text:
Why our People Choose Quickway
At the heart of our business are our greatest assets, our people, our culture and our core values of honesty, openness and fairness.
At Quickway, we are committed to nurturing talent and developing people. As we grow, we ensure that our people and their skills grow with us. Working with us, there are often opportunities to learn and build on your experience and we actively encourage professional development. We believe in building our people so that they can build Australia's future.
We partner with our clients and teams to deliver without compromising on our core values. We recognise and reward the efforts and achievements of our people.
Start Your Civil Engineering Career with Quickway
Quickway is a leading civil infrastructure contractor delivering projects across Roads & Bridges, Concrete Structures, Rail, Utilities, Communications, Electrical and Water Infrastructure throughout NSW and QLD.
We are seeking an enthusiastic Undergraduate Civil Engineer to join our team based at our Burleigh Waters Project in Queensland.
This opportunity is ideal for a 3rd or 4th year Civil Engineering student looking to gain practical, hands-on experience while completing their degree. Whether you are seeking your first engineering role, vocational placement or looking to gain exposure to live civil construction projects, we would love to hear from you.
No prior industry experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, willingness to learn and genuine interest in building a career in civil engineering.
About the Role
You will be part of the project team delivering the Cassowary Drive Bridge Replacement project, which has just kicked off, and will run through to completion in the second half of 2027. The project is a $18 million infrastructure project delivering a new flood-resilient bridge and improved transport connectivity for the growing southern Gold Coast community. Working alongside experienced Project Engineers, Site Supervisors and Project Managers, you will gain exposure to all aspects of project delivery including:
- Site-based engineering and construction activities
- Quality assurance and project documentation
- Construction methodologies and planning
- Safety and environmental compliance
- Subcontractor coordination
- Site inspections and reporting
- Quantity tracking and progress monitoring
- Survey and set out activities
- Contract administration and project controls
This is a hands-on role that will provide valuable exposure to the civil construction industry while allowing you to continue your university studies.
What You Will Bring
Essential
- Currently studying a Bachelor of Civil Engineering.
- In your 3rd or 4th year of study.
- Ability to travel to our Burleigh Waters project site.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
- Full working rights in Australia with the intention of pursuing a long-term career in Australia.
- A genuine interest in civil construction and infrastructure projects.
Desirable
- Current Driver's Licence.
- Previous construction, labouring or site-based experience.
- Completion of vocational placement or internship programs.
- White Card.
What We Offer
- Flexible work arrangements to support university commitments.
- Approximately 3 days per week with additional hours available during semester breaks and project requirements.
- Exposure to major civil infrastructure projects.
- Mentoring from experienced industry professionals.
- Practical experience that complements your university studies.
- Opportunity to transition into a Graduate Engineer role upon completion of your degree.
- Supportive team culture focused on learning and development.
 If you are looking to gain real-world engineering experience, work alongside experienced professionals and build a long-term career in civil construction, we would love to hear from you.   Apply now or contact Suzi Dimech at suzid@quickway.com.au for further information.

- A Civil Engineering degree or relevant qualification
- 0–3 years' experience in civil or structural construction/engineering
- A strong interest in retaining wall design and geotechnical engineering
- PLAXIS experience and an understanding of geotechnical modelling
- Knowledge of retaining wall design principles and stability analysis
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications

- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication and organisational skills
- A practical understanding of construction methodologies

Experience or knowledge in the following will be highly regarded:

- Soil and foundation behaviour
- Slope and global stability analysis

As part of the Infrastructure Program, the Graduate Civil Engineer will contribute to projects that help shape how people move through, connect with and experience the City of Adelaide. You'll gain practical experience across the planning, design and delivery of civil infrastructure projects, working alongside experienced engineers and project teams.
From roads, footpaths and drainage to water sensitive urban design and transport infrastructure, you'll be exposed to a diverse range of projects and challenges. You'll also build experience working with consultants, contractors and a broad range of stakeholders, giving you an understanding of the project lifecycle from concept through to delivery.
This is an opportunity to turn your university knowledge into real-world experience, develop your technical and project skills and start building a career in an environment where your work can have a visible impact on the city around you.
To view a copy of the position description, please click here.

 - Graduated within approximately the last two years or are expecting to graduate within approximately the next 6 months in Civil Engineering.
 - Eligible to join Engineers Australia as a Graduate Engineer (GradIEAust) upon completion of tertiary qualification.
 - Knowledge of the principles and practice of civil engineering, and emerging trends, principles and operations with an understanding of civil engineering operations and function.

Our graduate program gives you a great opportunity to start building your career, while having our genuine impact on our City and our communities. For more information about what it's like to work for the City of Adelaide, including the benefits, please visit www.cityofadelaide.com.au/careers

Located in the geographic heart of Kaurna Country, the City of Adelaide celebrates its cultural heritage, unique natural surrounds and structures its footprint in a way that allows it to adapt to the changing needs of the community and a dynamic global landscape. Our focus is on our community's wellbeing and quality of life - investing in city improvements and on future planning, so we continue to design a liveable city where future generations can continue to live authentic and meaningful lives. This is an exciting opportunity to join our team and be a bigger part of our amazing city!
At the City of Adelaide, we thrive in an environment that is welcoming, inclusive and safe, and celebrates difference. We value and embrace our diverse perspectives and recognise the value diversity has in fuelling innovation and enabling brilliant experiences for our diverse community.

This role involves understanding how things actually get built and taking ownership from initial take-off through procurement, fabrication and construction.

- Produce practical, dimensioned 2D drawings, construction details, material schedules and cutting lists, considering constructability, material optimisation and installation methods
- Review supplier quotations, compare scope and pricing, identify exclusions and discrepancies, and raise missing information rather than make unsupported assumptions

- Check work, manage revisions and keep drawings, estimates and schedules aligned, liaising professionally with suppliers, consultants, clients and project teams
About you
- At least two years' hands-on experience in both estimating and drafting awnings and decks, or closely related light structural works

- Strong numerical skills, attention to detail, clear communication and a proactive approach to ownership, deadlines and problem-solving
- A trade, building, estimating, drafting or engineering qualification will be well regarded. Practical experience, demonstrated capability and attitude are equally important
About us
Loumac Constructions is a growing construction business working across significant infrastructure projects. You will work closely with the people building the projects and have the opportunity to develop across varied building works. Your drawings and estimates will move from plans through procurement and fabrication to on-site construction.
As part of the interview process, shortlisted applicants will complete a brief, supervised mock estimate and 2D drawing using a supplied sample awning or deck project.
The exercise will include a material take-off, key cost allowances and a clear, dimensioned drawing. You will be asked to explain your quantities, assumptions and accuracy checks. This is a demonstration of your own skills, not work on a live client project.

candidates.content_text:
Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
At Downer Energy & Utilities, we are looking for motivated and ambitious Graduate Engineers to join our team and contribute to delivering critical infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand.
As a Graduate Engineer, you will participate in a structured graduate program, with the possibility of rotating across various business functions and project environments. You will gain valuable hands on experience supporting operational, financial, programming and administrative activities while working alongside experienced industry professionals.
This role offers the opportunity to build your technical capability, develop commercial awareness and strengthen stakeholder engagement skills while contributing to projects that power and connect communities. Flexibility and mobility are essential, as project based work may require travel and relocation throughout Australia and/ or New Zealand. 
What We're Looking For
- Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering, completed in 2025 or due for completion by the end of 2026
- Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency
- Hold current driver's licence and availability to commence in February 2027
- A willingness to learn, an open mindset and a desire to build your professional career from the ground up
- Strong communication and relationship building skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn from experienced professionals
- A proactive, self motivated attitude with a commitment to ongoing development
What We Offer
At Downer, we are committed to developing our people and providing meaningful career opportunities.
You will benefit from:
- Exposure to major infrastructure and utilities projects across Australia
- Mentoring and support from experienced industry professionals
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Strong focus on safety, sustainability and innovation
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Competitive remuneration and employee benefits
- Opportunities for long term career growth within a leading infrastructure services provider 
About Energy & Utilities
Downer Energy & Utilities delivers end to end engineering, construction, maintenance and asset management services to customers across power, gas, water, telecommunications and renewable energy sectors. Our people work on some of Australia's most significant infrastructure projects, helping to build sustainable communities and support the nation's future energy needs.
At Downer, our success is driven by our people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, culturally diverse individuals and people with disabilities.
How to Apply
To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your application online including your resume and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about building a career in the utilities and infrastructure sector and are committed to delivering safe and sustainable outcomes for our customers and communities.
Please note: Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes, fees or costs from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Downer or its employees will become the property of Downer and Downer will not be liable for any associated fees.
